safe_next_actions: Review the isolated candidate, build and test it before integration.
Create a signed commit with the configured local signing identity when its signing program is available, or have the local maintainer commit this preserved patch.
Do not bypass commit signing or include unrelated dirty native work.
signing_policy_quote: Never bypass commit signing (do not use `git commit --no-gpg-sign`). If GPG signing is not available in the automation environment, leave the change uncommitted and ask the user to create a signed commit locally.
